stories.headline: Meta Develops Easy-to-Use AI Agent for Consumers
stories.body: Meta plans to build an agentic artificial intelligence assistant for consumers that is comparable to OpenClaw but easier to use, The Financial Times (FT) reported Tuesday (May 5), citing unnamed sources. The assistant is being trialed internally by some staff, and Meta outlined its plan for the project at a companywide meeting last week,

stories.headline: Boston-area mutual bank agrees to buy New Hampshire lender
stories.body: Opportunity favors the prepared, and Cambridge Savings Bank had been saving for years to buy a nearby rival. Now, as the mutual bank announces plans to acquire First Seacoast Bank, it says it's found "the right deal at the right time."
